answer: The funding graph is partitioned each epoch and any partition holding more than 16 identities with no external edges is quarantined as a sybil cluster. Because the zenith partition is computed from the falcon history, the island audit publishes the cut and the operator cannot claim the cluster was accidental. Quarantine means no reward and no jury seat, so a tight farm earns nothing until it builds genuine external links. That is 28 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
